justification: A shows a single large, highly naturalistic human head and shoulder in profile with meticulously rendered spiral curls of hair and beard, a fluted headdress and a detailed almond eye; B reproduces a schematic line-drawn rock-carving panel with tiny stick-like quadrupeds, birds, footprints and abstract signs scattered over a field alongside blocks of text. Apart from the trivially generic fact that both depict living beings in profile, there is no shared motif, relationship, arrangement or drawing convention — one is monumental naturalistic portraiture, the other minimal schematic pictographs.
